name: EPIC 206224320
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 8.3 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,375 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.85 solar masses and 8.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,682 K at its surface.
